schema: hierarchical v1: module tree + one wiring graph per class forward() (graphart/hier.py)

timm_test.rule: DLA, CSPNet, GhostNet (two sizes each); a family that does not trace losslessly is replaced by the next of HRNet, ReXNet, SelecSLS -- fixed before building

training_exclusions.why: holdout architectures (Swin, MaxViT, MViT) and the timm test families are never trained on
training_exclusions.generator: programs whose variant graphs are isomorphic to a whole holdout/timm-test program's are rejected

rules: Holdout and timm_test are scored ONCE, on the frozen setup, after a dated amendment to this file fixes the pipeline, the models and the comparisons -- written before any reply on them exists.
Never tune prompts, data, the generator or training on them; never generate replies on them before the amendment; never print or read their content while developing (the builder prints counts only).
The 17-sample flat holdout (FROZEN.json) stays spent and is not part of this protocol.
Caveat recorded at freezing: the holdout constructors were traced once on 19 Nov in a count of all torchvision models (counts only, no content looked at).

amendments.reason: assembler fix: real-code samples now include the plain classes (config dataclasses, not weight enums) and module-level constants their code uses; before, e.g. EfficientNet's MBConvConfig -- the only reference to MBConv -- and VGG's cfgs were missing. Found 21 Nov by a static undefined-name check on dev and timm training data; no holdout or timm-test content was looked at, and no reply on either set exists.

amendments.kind: scoring measure (declared before any reply on the frozen sets exists)
amendments.reason: The user's decision after reading the dev results (docs/experiments.md, 22 Nov): only the hierarchical drawing counts; how it expands to the flat fx graph carries no weight. This fixes how the frozen sets are scored. It does not yet fix the models or pipelines: they are named in a further dated amendment, also before any reply on these sets exists, and every pipeline named there is scored once, together.
amendments.headline: hier_right: the reply parses, the tree (with layer parameters, compared order-free) equals the truth's, the block instances fall into the same variant partition (up to renaming), and every visible variant's wiring graph is isomorphic to the truth's (node kind + target, edges with slot and selector). No inlining.
amendments.truth_conventions: Unchanged and strict: the truth's wiring is graphart/hier.py's as built. Known on dev/gen_test (22 Nov): a consumer of an nn.Identity placeholder is wired past it in the truth, and one variant split into two identical ones counts as a wrong partition. Neither is relaxed for the frozen run.
reported_with_it: split by kind (block / network) and by family
tree (no params), tree, variants, variant graphs right (count), all wiring, tree F1
flat exact (inlined graph == fx, node labels) as a secondary column only
amendments.comparisons: Between two pipelines on the same programs: exact McNemar on the discordant programs for hier_right. Thresholds for success are declared with the pipelines in the next amendment.
